_doc: All 44 classification + 13 regression Bio datasets. This result tree is seeded from the frozen 40+13 run, then completed via prepare -> sharded array -> finalize. The source tree is copied read-only and never extended in place.
_samples_doc: 5000 is omitted: the largest training split in the corpus is 3118 rows, so every cell on that budget was a duplicate of the full-sample cell and produced no fits.
